subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what upload validation, storage, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The issue is useful but adds a new server-side file upload and workspace-write path, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow admin-authenticated upload flow with explicit image validation, path containment, and canonical identity update behavior.

options.title: Keep local/manual paths
options.body: Continue supporting browser-local assistant override and manual CLI/config identity avatar paths without server-side upload.

options.title: Defer identity management
options.body: Keep this open or close by maintainer decision until a broader Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow admin-authenticated upload flow with explicit image validation, path containment, and canonical identity update behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest combined history on avatar security hardening, current Control UI avatar behavior, and original avatar support merge provenance.
